text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She claimed victory over Admire Vega in 
the Japanese Derby. Yet for Meisho Doto, 
there was no one to whom she could 
dedicate this win...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega left after acknowledging their 
good fight. Watching her leave, the desire 
grew: "I want to be able to run for 
someone else's sake too, someday."
